messages:
nikhil.sre: Scheduling a simulated inter-region peering failover rehearsal for Fri 2026-05-22 01:00-01:45 UTC for us-east-1 <-> us-west-2. Objective: validate smart-routing failover, model-variant fallbacks, and SLO guardrails for both hosted and dedicated customers.

rachel.netops: Are we simulating a full peering flap or just asymmetric path degradation?

ikhil.sre: We'll simulate asymmetric degradation (30% packet loss one-way) for 10m, then escalate to an egress-block on a subset of routers for 5m to force routing shifts. All simulated via the net-sim tool on the control plane (no real provider changes).

taylor.prod: Will dedicated customers be excluded from automatic cross-region failover? we need to respect isolation contracts.

ikhil.sre: Yes 1: policy: dedicated pools marked "no-cross-region-failover" will be kept local; we'll only test dedicated-safe actions (prefetch hints, admission tuning). Hosted traffic will exercise full smart-routing. We'll tag traffic groups explicitly in the rehearsal job.

leah.oncall: Draft runbook steps?

ikhil.sre: TL;DR runbook: 1) preflight checks, 2) start asymmetric loss sim on control-plane with canary traffic groups, 3) observe smart-router decisions and model-fallback counts, 4) escalate to egress-block on subset if needed, 5) revert network sim and verify reconvergence. Abort if error-rate >0.6% absolute or P95 >500ms for 10m.

ops-bot: Automated guard: will open an incident if error-rate >0.6% OR P99 delta >400ms sustained 10m.

rachel.netops: net-sim commands we'll run (internal):
```
# create asymmetric loss on peering link
netsim --link us-east-usw2 --loss 30 --duration 600 --tag rehearsal-1991234567
# escalate to egress-block on routers 3-4
netsim --router-set r3,r4 --egress-block --duration 300 --tag rehearsal-1991234567
```

nikhil.sre: Smart-routing knob commands (for ops):
```
# set smart-routing to simulate fallback aggressiveness
curl -X POST https://internal-config/smartroute -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"us-east-1","fallbackAggressiveness":0.8}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://internal-config/smartroute -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"us-east-1","fallbackAggressiveness":0.5}'
```

leah.oncall: who owns monitoring during the window?

nikhil.sre: Leah will own pager channel. Taylor will watch customer-impact metrics and coordinate with support. Rachel will watch net-sim health. I'll own the rollout.

deploy-bot: rehearsal job created: job_id=interregion-rehearsal-1991234567, canary-hosted=5%, dedicated-sim=false

infra-bot: Capacity check: us-west-2 and us-east-1 hosted pools have 14% and 16% spare capacity respectively. Dedicated pools unaffected.

taylor.prod: We'll run a synthetic SDK smoke suite after each phase to validate client behaviour. Command: `scripts/smoke_global --regions us-east-1,us-west-2 --token $SMOKE_TOKEN`

support-bot: Support heads: please stand by 30m before start; prepare canned response if customers question cross-region routing.

nikhil.sre: Abort criteria repeated: error-rate >0.6% absolute; sustained P95 delta >500ms for 10m; or >200 model-fallbacks/min sustained for 5m. If abort -> net-sim stop, revert smart-routing, kill rehearsal job, and open incident.

rachel.netops: We'll run a preflight BGP convergence check 15m before start and post the result here.

leah.oncall: I'll update the oncall runbook with the exact abort steps and add quick rollback commands.

nikhil.sre: Post-run checklist: capture routing traces, per-route latency histograms, model-fallback logs, and admission queue lengths. PR checklist: update internal postmortem template with rehearsal notes.

taylor.prod: Also capture SDK error rates and any client-side retries to quantify end-user impact.

nikhil.sre: last note: If any app team wants to opt-out their traffic from the hosted canary, DM me before Thu 23:59 UTC. We'll post a status update if the rehearsal triggers an abort. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
